sanskrit: tato mūrdhnā nipatitaṃ vānaraṃ vānararṣabhaḥ dṛṣṭvaivodvignahṛdayo vākyam etad uvāca ha
english: Then the bull among monkeys, seeing the monkey fallen at his feet with bowed head, was troubled at heart and spoke these words.

sanskrit: uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha kasmāt tvaṃ pādayoḥ patito mama abhayaṃ te bhaved vīra satyam evābhidhīyatām
english: "Rise, rise! Why have you fallen at my feet? You shall have no fear, O hero — speak only the truth."

sanskrit: sa tu viśvāsitas tena sugrīveṇa mahātmanā utthāya ca mahāprājño vākyaṃ dadhimukho 'bravīt
english: Reassured by that great-souled Sugrīva, the highly wise Dadhimukha rose up and spoke.

sanskrit: naivarkṣarajasā rājan na tvayā nāpi vālinā vanaṃ nisṛṣṭapūrvaṃ hi bhakṣitaṃ tat tu vānaraiḥ
english: "O king, this grove was never granted to be enjoyed — not by Ṛkṣarajas, not by you, not by Vālin — yet those monkeys have eaten of it.

sanskrit: ebhiḥ pradharṣitāś caiva vāritā vanarakṣibhiḥ madhūny acintayitvemān bhakṣayanti pibanti ca
english: Even though the grove-wardens restrained and forbade them, these monkeys, heedless of us, ate and drank the honey.

sanskrit: śiṣṭam atrāpavidhyanti bhakṣayanti tathāpare nivāryamāṇās te sarve bhruvau vai darśayanti hi
english: Some threw away what remained; others ate it; and all of them, when stopped, merely raised their eyebrows in contempt.

sanskrit: ime hi saṃrabdhatarās tathā taiḥ saṃpradharṣitāḥ vārayanto vanāt tasmāt kruddhair vānarapuṃgavaiḥ
english: The wardens, in trying to bar those best of monkeys from the grove, were then set upon and assaulted by those furious monkey-bulls.

sanskrit: tatas tair bahubhir vīrair vānarair vānararṣabhāḥ saṃraktanayanaiḥ krodhād dharayaḥ saṃpracālitāḥ
english: Then those many heroic monkeys, eyes reddened with fury, O bull among monkeys, struck down the wardens.

sanskrit: pāṇibhir nihatāḥ ke cit ke cij jānubhir āhatāḥ prakṛṣṭāś ca yathākāmaṃ devamārgaṃ ca darśitāḥ
english: Some were beaten with fists, some struck with knees; others were dragged about at will and shown the sky — hurled through the air.

sanskrit: evam ete hatāḥ śūrās tvayi tiṣṭhati bhartari kṛtsnaṃ madhuvanaṃ caiva prakāmaṃ taiḥ prabhakṣyate
english: Thus our brave wardens have been beaten while you, their lord, still reign; and the entire Madhuvana has been eaten by them to their fill.

sanskrit: evaṃ vijñāpyamānaṃ tu sugrīvaṃ vānararṣabham apṛcchat taṃ mahāprājño lakṣmaṇaḥ paravīrahā
english: While Sugrīva, bull among monkeys, was being informed thus, the highly wise Lakṣmaṇa, slayer of enemy heroes, questioned him.

sanskrit: kim ayaṃ vānaro rājan vanapaḥ pratyupasthitaḥ kaṃ cārtham abhinirdiśya duḥkhito vākyam abravīt
english: "O king, why has this grove-keeper monkey come to present himself before you? Indicating what matter did he speak in distress?"

sanskrit: evam uktas tu sugrīvo lakṣmaṇena mahātmanā lakṣmaṇaṃ pratyuvācedaṃ vākyaṃ vākyaviśāradaḥ
english: Thus addressed by the great-souled Lakṣmaṇa, Sugrīva, skilled in speech, replied to him in these words.

sanskrit: ārya lakṣmaṇa saṃprāha vīro dadhimukhaḥ kapiḥ aṅgadapramukhair vīrair bhakṣitaṃ madhuvānaraiḥ
english: "Noble Lakṣmaṇa, the brave monkey Dadhimukha reports that the Madhuvana has been consumed by the heroes led by Aṅgada.

sanskrit: naiṣām akṛtakṛtyānām īdṛśaḥ syād upakramaḥ vanaṃ yathābhipannaṃ taiḥ sādhitaṃ karma vānaraiḥ
english: Such boldness as this would not belong to monkeys who had failed in their mission; by entering that grove they have signalled that their task is accomplished.

sanskrit: dṛṣṭā devī na saṃdeho na cānyena hanūmatā na hy anyaḥ sādhane hetuḥ karmaṇo 'sya hanūmataḥ
english: Without doubt the goddess Sītā has been found — and by none other than Hanūmān; for there is no other agent capable of accomplishing this deed but Hanūmān.

sanskrit: kāryasiddhir hanumati matiś ca haripuṃgava vyavasāyaś ca vīryaṃ ca śrutaṃ cāpi pratiṣṭhitam
english: O best of monkeys, success in this mission rests in Hanūmān — the resolve, the valour, the learning, all are firmly established in him.

sanskrit: jāmbavān yatra netā syād aṅgadasya baleśvaraḥ hanūmāṃś cāpy adhiṣṭhātā na tasya gatir anyathā
english: Where Jāmbavān is the guide, Aṅgada the lord of the host, and Hanūmān the presiding spirit, the outcome cannot be otherwise.

sanskrit: aṅgadapramukhair vīrair hataṃ madhuvanaṃ kila vicintya dakṣiṇām āśām āgatair haripuṃgavaiḥ
english: The Madhuvana has been ravaged by the valiant heroes led by Aṅgada — those best of monkeys who have returned having searched the southern quarter.

sanskrit: āgataiś ca praviṣṭaṃ tad yathā madhuvanaṃ hi taiḥ dharṣitaṃ ca vanaṃ kṛtsnam upayuktaṃ ca vānaraiḥ vāritāḥ sahitāḥ pālās tathā jānubhir āhatāḥ
english: Having returned, they entered the Madhuvana and the monkeys ravaged the entire grove and enjoyed it to the full; the wardens who tried to stop them together were struck with knees.

sanskrit: etadartham ayaṃ prāpto vaktuṃ madhuravāg iha nāmnā dadhimukho nāma hariḥ prakhyātavikramaḥ
english: It is for this purpose that this sweet-spoken monkey of celebrated prowess, named Dadhimukha, has come here to report."

sanskrit: dṛṣṭā sītā mahābāho saumitre paśya tattvataḥ abhigamya yathā sarve pibanti madhu vānarāḥ
english: "O great-armed Saumitri, consider the truth of it: Sītā has been found — see how all the monkeys drink honey upon arriving there!"

sanskrit: na cāpy adṛṣṭvā vaidehīṃ viśrutāḥ puruṣarṣabha vanaṃ dātta varaṃ divyaṃ dharṣayeyur vanaukasaḥ
english: "O bull among men, renowned monkeys would not dare to violate the divine grove granted as a boon, without having first found the daughter of Videha."

sanskrit: tataḥ prahṛṣṭo dharmātmā lakṣmaṇaḥ saharāghavaḥ śrutvā karṇasukhāṃ vāṇīṃ sugrīvavadanāc cyutām
english: Then Lakṣmaṇa, righteous in spirit, together with Rāghava, was filled with joy upon hearing the sweet words that flowed from Sugrīva's mouth.

sanskrit: prāhṛṣyata bhṛśaṃ rāmo lakṣmaṇaś ca mahāyaśāḥ śrutvā dadhimukhasyedaṃ sugrīvas tu prahṛṣya ca vanapālaṃ punar vākyaṃ sugrīvaḥ pratyabhāṣata
english: Rāma rejoiced greatly, and so did the greatly glorious Lakṣmaṇa; and Sugrīva, himself overjoyed at hearing Dadhimukha's report, addressed the grove-keeper once more.

sanskrit: prīto 'smi saumya yad bhuktaṃ vanaṃ taiḥ kṛtakarmabhiḥ marṣitaṃ marṣaṇīyaṃ ca ceṣṭitaṃ kṛtakarmaṇām
english: "Dear friend, I am pleased that those who have accomplished the work ate of the grove; what those who have done their duty have done is entirely fitting and must be pardoned."

sanskrit: icchāmi śīghraṃ hanumatpradhānān śākhāmṛgāṃs tān mṛgarājadarpān draṣṭuṃ kṛtārthān saha rāghavābhyāṃ śrotuṃ ca sītādhigame prayatnam
english: "I desire at once to see those tree-leaping monkeys led by Hanūmān — bold as lions, their mission accomplished — together with the two Rāghavas, and to hear the effort made in finding Sītā."

sanskrit: sugrīveṇaivam uktas tu hṛṣṭo dadhimukhaḥ kapiḥ rāghavaṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ caiva sugrīvaṃ cābhyavādayat
english: Thus addressed by Sugrīva, the delighted monkey Dadhimukha paid obeisance to Rāghava, to Lakṣmaṇa, and to Sugrīva.

sanskrit: sa praṇamya ca sugrīvaṃ rāghavau ca mahābalau vānaraiḥ sahitaiḥ śūrair divam evotpapāta ha
english: Having bowed to Sugrīva and to the two mighty Rāghavas, he leapt up into the sky together with his company of brave monkeys.

sanskrit: sa yathaivāgataḥ pūrvaṃ tathaiva tvarito gataḥ nipatya gaganād bhūmau tad vanaṃ praviveśa ha
english: Just as he had come, so he went back swiftly; descending from the sky to the earth, he entered that grove.

sanskrit: sa praviṣṭo madhuvanaṃ dadarśa hariyūthapān vimadān uddhatān sarvān mehamānān madhūdakam
english: Entering the Madhuvana, he found all the monkey-troop leaders, freed of their intoxication yet still elated, urinating the honey-liquor.

sanskrit: sa tān upāgamad vīro baddhvā karapuṭāñjalim uvāca vacanaṃ ślakṣṇam idaṃ hṛṣṭavad aṅgadam
english: That hero approached them and, joining his cupped palms in añjali, spoke these gentle words in a tone of gladness to Aṅgada.

sanskrit: saumya roṣo na kartavyo yad ebhir abhivāritaḥ ajñānād rakṣibhiḥ krodhād bhavantaḥ pratiṣedhitāḥ
english: "Dear lord, let there be no anger over the fact that the wardens who stopped you did so in anger and out of ignorance — they did not know who you were."

sanskrit: yuvarājas tvam īśaś ca vanasyāsya mahābala maurkhyāt pūrvaṃ kṛto doṣas tad bhavān kṣantum arhati
english: "O greatly powerful one, you are the crown prince and lord of this forest; the offence was committed beforehand out of foolishness — it befits you to forgive it."

sanskrit: yathaiva hi pitā te 'bhūt pūrvaṃ harigaṇeśvaraḥ tathā tvam api sugrīvo nānyas tu harisattama
english: "Just as your father formerly was lord of the monkey host, so too is Sugrīva — no other, O best of monkeys."

sanskrit: ākhyātaṃ hi mayā gatvā pitṛvyasya tavānagha ihopayānaṃ sarveṣām eteṣāṃ vanacāriṇām
english: "O sinless one, I have gone and reported to your paternal uncle the arrival here of all these forest-wandering monkeys."

sanskrit: sa tvadāgamanaṃ śrutvā sahaibhir hariyūthapaiḥ prahṛṣṭo na tu ruṣṭo 'sau vanaṃ śrutvā pradharṣitam
english: "He, upon hearing of your coming together with these monkey-troop leaders, was overjoyed — not at all angry upon hearing that the grove was ravaged."

sanskrit: prahṛṣṭo māṃ pitṛvyas te sugrīvo vānareśvaraḥ śīghraṃ preṣaya sarvāṃs tān iti hovāca pārthivaḥ
english: "Your paternal uncle Sugrīva, lord of monkeys, rejoicing, commanded me the king: 'Send them all here swiftly.'"

sanskrit: śrutvā dadhimukhasyaitad vacanaṃ ślakṣṇam aṅgadaḥ abravīt tān hariśreṣṭho vākyaṃ vākyaviśāradaḥ
english: Hearing this gentle speech of Dadhimukha, Aṅgada, best of monkeys and skilled in speech, addressed those monkeys with words.

sanskrit: śaṅke śruto 'yaṃ vṛttānto rāmeṇa hariyūthapāḥ tat kṣamaṃ neha naḥ sthātuṃ kṛte kārye paraṃtapāḥ
english: "I think this whole account has been heard by Rāma, O troop-leaders of the monkeys; now that our mission is done, it is not fitting for us to remain here, O afflicters of foes."

sanskrit: pītvā madhu yathākāmaṃ viśrāntā vanacāriṇaḥ kiṃ śeṣaṃ gamanaṃ tatra sugrīvo yatra me guruḥ
english: "O forest-wanderers, having drunk honey to our satisfaction and rested, what remains but to go there where my elder, Sugrīva, awaits?"

sanskrit: sarve yathā māṃ vakṣyanti sametya hariyūthapāḥ tathāsmi kartā kartavye bhavadbhiḥ paravān aham
english: "I shall act in accordance with what all the troop-leaders say when they come together; I am dependent on you all in what must be done."

sanskrit: nājñāpayitum īśo 'haṃ yuvarājo 'smi yady api ayuktaṃ kṛtakarmāṇo yūyaṃ dharṣayituṃ mayā
english: "I am not fit to issue commands, even though I am crown prince; it would be improper for me to overrule you who have accomplished the mission."

sanskrit: bruvataś cāṅgadaś caivaṃ śrutvā vacanam avyayam prahṛṣṭamanaso vākyam idam ūcur vanaukasaḥ
english: As Aṅgada spoke thus, the forest-dwellers heard his imperishable words and, their hearts filled with joy, spoke these words.

sanskrit: evaṃ vakṣyati ko rājan prabhuḥ san vānararṣabha aiśvaryamadamatto hi sarvo 'ham iti manyate
english: "O king, O bull among monkeys, who, being a master, would speak thus? Every man intoxicated with the pride of lordship thinks only of himself."

sanskrit: tava cedaṃ susadṛśaṃ vākyaṃ nānyasya kasya cit saṃnatir hi tavākhyāti bhaviṣyac chubhabhāgyatām
english: "These words are most fitting for you alone, not for any other; your humility proclaims the auspicious fortune that lies ahead for you."

sanskrit: sarve vayam api prāptās tatra gantuṃ kṛtakṣaṇāḥ sa yatra harivīrāṇāṃ sugrīvaḥ patir avyayaḥ
english: "We are all ready and the moment is right to go there where the undying Sugrīva, lord of the valiant monkeys, abides."

sanskrit: tvayā hy anuktair haribhir naiva śakyaṃ padāt padam kva cid gantuṃ hariśreṣṭha brūmaḥ satyam idaṃ tu te
english: "O best of monkeys, monkeys unsummoned by you cannot move a single step anywhere — this we tell you truly."

sanskrit: evaṃ tu vadatāṃ teṣām aṅgadaḥ pratyabhāṣata bāḍhaṃ gacchāma ity uktvā utpapāta mahītalāt
english: As they spoke thus, Aṅgada replied to them; saying "Very well, let us go," he leapt up from the surface of the earth.

sanskrit: utpatantam anūtpetuḥ sarve te hariyūthapāḥ kṛtvākāśaṃ nirākāśaṃ yajñotkṣiptā ivānalāḥ
english: All those monkey-troop leaders leapt up after him as he leapt, filling the sky to overflowing, like flames flung up by a sacrifice.

sanskrit: te 'mbaraṃ sahasotpatya vegavantaḥ plavaṃgamāḥ vinadanto mahānādaṃ ghanā vāteritā yathā
english: Those swift-moving monkeys, leaping at once into the sky, roared with great cries, like clouds driven by the wind.

sanskrit: aṅgade hy ananuprāpte sugrīvo vānarādhipaḥ uvāca śokopahataṃ rāmaṃ kamalalocanam
english: While Aṅgada had not yet arrived, Sugrīva, lord of monkeys, spoke to lotus-eyed Rāma who was afflicted with grief.

sanskrit: samāśvasihi bhadraṃ te dṛṣṭā devī na saṃśayaḥ nāgantum iha śakyaṃ tair atīte samaye hi naḥ
english: "Take heart — good fortune to you! The goddess Sītā has been found, without doubt; they could not have come here if the time allotted had passed."

sanskrit: na matsakāśam āgacchet kṛtye hi vinipātite yuvarājo mahābāhuḥ plavatāṃ pravaro 'ṅgadaḥ
english: "The crown prince, great-armed Aṅgada, best among leapers, would not have come to me if the mission had been a failure."

sanskrit: yady apy akṛtakṛtyānām īdṛśaḥ syād upakramaḥ bhavet tu dīnavadano bhrāntaviplutamānasaḥ
english: "Even if the conduct of one who had not accomplished the task were such as this, his face would be downcast and his mind wandering and confused."

sanskrit: pitṛpaitāmahaṃ caitat pūrvakair abhirakṣitam na me madhuvanaṃ hanyād ahṛṣṭaḥ plavageśvaraḥ
english: "This Madhuvana, guarded by our forebears and inherited from father and grandfather, no lord of monkeys bereft of joy would dare to ravage."

sanskrit: kausalyā suprajā rāma samāśvasihi suvrata dṛṣṭā devī na saṃdeho na cānyena hanūmatā na hy anyaḥ karmaṇo hetuḥ sādhane tadvidho bhavet
english: "O Rāma of good vows, Kausalyā is blessed in her son — take comfort! The goddess Sītā has been found, beyond doubt, and by none other than Hanūmān; no other agent of that kind could have accomplished this deed."

sanskrit: hanūmati hi siddhiś ca matiś ca matisattama vyavasāyaś ca vīryaṃ ca sūrye teja iva dhruvam
english: "O best of the wise, success, intelligence, determination, and valour are fixed in Hanūmān as surely as radiance is fixed in the sun."

sanskrit: jāmbavān yatra netā syād aṅgadaś ca baleśvaraḥ hanūmāṃś cāpy adhiṣṭhātā na tasya gatir anyathā
english: "Where Jāmbavān is the guide, Aṅgada the lord of the host, and Hanūmān the presiding spirit, the outcome cannot be otherwise."

sanskrit: mā bhūś cintā samāyuktaḥ saṃpraty amitavikrama
english: "O you of boundless valour, be not prey to anxiety any longer."

sanskrit: tataḥ kila kilā śabdaṃ śuśrāvāsannam ambare hanūmat karmadṛptānāṃ nardatāṃ kānanaukasām kiṣkindhām upayātānāṃ siddhiṃ kathayatām iva
english: Then he heard nearby in the sky the kilakila shout of the forest-dwellers intoxicated with their achievement, roaring as they approached Kiṣkindhā, as if proclaiming their success.

sanskrit: tataḥ śrutvā ninādaṃ taṃ kapīnāṃ kapisattamaḥ āyatāñcitalāṅgūlaḥ so 'bhavad dhṛṣṭamānasaḥ
english: Then, upon hearing that roar of the monkeys, that best of monkeys — his long tail raised and curled — became glad at heart.

sanskrit: ājagmus te 'pi harayo rāmadarśanakāṅkṣiṇaḥ aṅgadaṃ purataḥ kṛtvā hanūmantaṃ ca vānaram
english: Those monkeys came too, eager to see Rāma, placing Aṅgada and the monkey Hanūmān at their head.

sanskrit: te 'ṅgadapramukhā vīrāḥ prahṛṣṭāś ca mudānvitāḥ nipetur harirājasya samīpe rāghavasya ca
english: Those heroes led by Aṅgada, filled with delight and joy, alighted near the king of monkeys and near Rāghava.

sanskrit: hanūmāṃś ca mahābahuḥ praṇamya śirasā tataḥ niyatām akṣatāṃ devīṃ rāghavāya nyavedayat
english: And great-armed Hanūmān, having bowed his head in reverence, announced to Rāghava that the goddess Sītā was well and unharmed.

sanskrit: niścitārthaṃ tatas tasmin sugrīvaṃ pavanātmaje lakṣmaṇaḥ prītimān prītaṃ bahumānād avaikṣata
english: Then, with the matter resolved in Hanūmān, the son of the Wind, Lakṣmaṇa looked upon the pleased Sugrīva with affection and great esteem.

sanskrit: prītyā ca ramamāṇo 'tha rāghavaḥ paravīrahā bahu mānena mahatā hanūmantam avaikṣata
english: And Rāghava, slayer of enemy heroes, delighting in his joy, looked upon Hanūmān with the greatest honour and esteem.

sanskrit: tataḥ prasravaṇaṃ śailaṃ te gatvā citrakānanam praṇamya śirasā rāmaṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ ca mahābalam
english: Then those monkeys went to Mount Prasravaṇa with its colourful forest and bowed their heads to Rāma and to the mighty Lakṣmaṇa.

sanskrit: yuvarājaṃ puraskṛtya sugrīvam abhivādya ca pravṛttam atha sītāyāḥ pravaktum upacakramuḥ
english: Placing the crown prince Aṅgada at their head, and having saluted Sugrīva, they began to report what had happened concerning Sītā.

sanskrit: rāvaṇāntaḥpure rodhaṃ rākṣasībhiś ca tarjanam rāme samanurāgaṃ ca yaś cāpi samayaḥ kṛtaḥ
english: They told of her confinement in Rāvaṇa's inner chambers, the threats made by the rākṣasī women, her deep devotion to Rāma, and the compact that had been made.

sanskrit: etad ākhyānti te sarve harayo rāma saṃnidhau vaidehīm akṣatāṃ śrutvā rāmas tūttaram abravīt
english: All those monkeys reported this in Rāma's presence; and upon hearing that the daughter of Videha was unharmed, Rāma spoke in reply.

sanskrit: kva sītā vartate devī kathaṃ ca mayi vartate etan me sarvam ākhyāta vaidehīṃ prati vānarāḥ
english: "Where does the goddess Sītā dwell, and how does she bear herself toward me? Tell me everything regarding the daughter of Videha, O monkeys."

sanskrit: rāmasya gaditaṃ śrutva harayo rāmasaṃnidhau codayanti hanūmantaṃ sītāvṛttāntakovidam
english: Having heard Rāma's words, the monkeys in Rāma's presence urged Hanūmān, who was expert in the particulars of Sītā's situation.

sanskrit: śrutvā tu vacanaṃ teṣāṃ hanūmān mārutātmajaḥ uvāca vākyaṃ vākyajñaḥ sītāyā darśanaṃ yathā
english: Hearing their words, Hanūmān, the son of the Wind God, skilled in speech, spoke, recounting exactly how he had seen Sītā.

sanskrit: samudraṃ laṅghayitvāhaṃ śatayojanam āyatam agacchaṃ jānakīṃ sītāṃ mārgamāṇo didṛkṣayā
english: "Having leapt across the ocean stretching a hundred yojanas in breadth, I went searching with longing to see Jānakī Sītā."

sanskrit: tatra laṅketi nagarī rāvaṇasya durātmanaḥ dakṣiṇasya samudrasya tīre vasati dakṣiṇe
english: "There stands Laṅkā, the city of the evil-souled Rāvaṇa, on the southern shore of the southern ocean."

sanskrit: tatra dṛṣṭā mayā sītā rāvaṇāntaḥpure satī saṃnyasya tvayi jīvantī rāmā rāma manoratham
english: "There I found Sītā, the virtuous one, in Rāvaṇa's inner chambers, living still, having set all her hope upon you, O Rāma."

sanskrit: dṛṣṭā me rākṣasī madhye tarjyamānā muhur muhuḥ rākṣasībhir virūpābhī rakṣitā pramadāvane
english: "I saw her in the midst of rākṣasī women, threatened again and again, guarded by misshapen rākṣasīs in the pleasure grove."

sanskrit: duḥkham āpadyate devī tavāduḥkhocitā satī rāvaṇāntaḥpure ruddhvā rākṣasībhiḥ surakṣitā
english: "The goddess, she who is not accustomed to sorrow, suffers great distress, confined in Rāvaṇa's inner chambers and closely guarded by the rākṣasī women."

sanskrit: ekaveṇīdharā dīnā tvayi cintāparāyaṇā adhaḥśayyā vivarṇāṅgī padminīva himāgame
english: "She wears her hair in a single braid, wretched, absorbed in thoughts of you, sleeping on the ground, her limbs discoloured — like a lotus pond at the onset of winter."

sanskrit: rāvaṇād vinivṛttārthā martavyakṛtaniścayā devī kathaṃ cit kākutstha tvanmanā mārgitā mayā
english: "The goddess, her desire turned utterly away from Rāvaṇa, resolved to die — thinking of you alone, O Kākutstha, she was somehow found by me."

sanskrit: ikṣvākuvaṃśavikhyātiṃ śanaiḥ kīrtayatānagha sa mayā naraśārdūla viśvāsam upapāditā
english: "O sinless tiger among men, I gradually won her trust by recounting your fame and the glory of the Ikṣvāku lineage."

sanskrit: tataḥ saṃbhāṣitā devī sarvam arthaṃ ca darśitā rāmasugrīvasakhyaṃ ca śrutvā prītim upāgatā
english: "Then the goddess was spoken to and shown the full state of affairs; upon hearing of the friendship between Rāma and Sugrīva, she was filled with joy."

sanskrit: niyataḥ samudācāro bhaktiś cāsyās tathā tvayi evaṃ mayā mahābhāgā dṛṣṭā janakanandinī ugreṇa tapasā yuktā tvadbhaktyā puruṣarṣabha
english: "Her devotion and steadfast conduct toward you are unwavering; thus was the greatly blessed daughter of Janaka seen by me, O bull among men, enduring fierce austerity sustained by her devotion to you."

sanskrit: abhijñānaṃ ca me dattaṃ yathāvṛttaṃ tavāntike citrakūṭe mahāprājña vāyasaṃ prati rāghava
english: "A token of recognition was given to me by her — the incident as it truly occurred between you and the crow at Citrakūṭa, O Rāghava of great wisdom."

sanskrit: vijñāpyaś ca nara vyāghro rāmo vāyusuta tvayā akhileneha yad dṛṣṭam iti mām āha jānakī
english: "'The tiger among men, Rāma, should be informed by you, O son of the Wind, of everything that was seen here' — thus Jānakī told me."

sanskrit: idaṃ cāsmai pradātavyaṃ yatnāt suparirakṣitam bruvatā vacanāny evaṃ sugrīvasyopaśṛṇvataḥ
english: "'And this token, carefully preserved, should be given to him' — speaking these words even as Sugrīva listened."

sanskrit: eṣa cūḍāmaṇiḥ śrīmān mayā te yatnarakṣitaḥ manaḥśilāyās tikalas taṃ smarasveti cābravīt
english: "'This glorious crest-jewel has been guarded by me with great care for you; and also the tika-mark of manaḥśilā mineral — remember that occasion,' she said."

sanskrit: eṣa niryātitaḥ śrīmān mayā te vārisaṃbhavaḥ etaṃ dṛṣṭvā pramodiṣye vyasane tvām ivānagha
english: "'This glorious jewel born of water is now rendered up by me to you; seeing this, O sinless one, I shall take joy in my affliction as if I saw you yourself,' she said."

sanskrit: jīvitaṃ dhārayiṣyāmi māsaṃ daśarathātmaja ūrdhvaṃ māsān na jīveyaṃ rakṣasāṃ vaśam āgatā
english: "'I shall sustain my life for one month, O son of Daśaratha; beyond a month I cannot live, fallen under the power of the rākṣasas,' she said."

sanskrit: iti mām abravīt sītā kṛśāṅgī dharma cāriṇī rāvaṇāntaḥpure ruddhā mṛgīvotphullalocanā
english: "Thus spoke Sītā to me — slender-limbed, righteous in conduct, imprisoned in Rāvaṇa's inner chambers, her wide eyes like those of a doe."

sanskrit: etad eva mayākhyātaṃ sarvaṃ rāghava yad yathā sarvathā sāgarajale saṃtāraḥ pravidhīyatām
english: "All this I have reported to you exactly as it occurred, O Rāghava; now by every means let the crossing of the ocean's waters be arranged."

sanskrit: tau jātāśvāsau rājaputrau viditvā tac cābhijñānaṃ rāghavāya pradāya devyā cākhyātaṃ sarvam evānupūrvyād vācā saṃpūrṇaṃ vāyuputraḥ śaśaṃsa
english: Both princes having thus found reassurance, and the token having been presented to Rāghava, the son of the Wind narrated in full with complete words, in order, everything that the goddess had related.
